gender-lgbtq.quote: Sophie Cunningham just became one of the first current American female pro athletes to come out against men playing in women’s sports in an @espn profile article. Good for her. Rock star. Many others should follow. She’s the anti-Megan Rapinoe.

So ESPN fired Ryan Clark yesterday and today dropped an extremely favorable long form piece where Sophie Cunningham said men shouldn’t be playing women’s sports. Hell of a 48 hours for ESPN. Major culture change underway at long last. Bravo.

1. There are way more than five. 2. But if only five 20 year olds were playing 12U baseball and we said the five 20 year olds shouldn’t play 12U baseball would you call us “evil, vile grifters” for not wanting the adults in 12U baseball?

The way to solve this issue forever is for all men and boys not to play women’s and girls sports at all anywhere. But you guys won’t do that, why? It’s not us making this is an issue, it’s you guys. If it’s only a small handful, why not just end it?
